# wolfssh / fuzz_server

wolfssh's own fuzz target `fuzz_server` ([source](source/fuzz_server.c), modified; see below), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over wolfssh (wolfssl/wolfssh at bfe6fe0f).

Server-side wolfSSH_accept over a recv callback that serves the input (sends discarded, user auth always succeeds); the accept result is explicitly ignored ("we only care about memory-safety issues").

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against wolfssh at commit bfe6fe0f.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.
- The harness source differs from the upstream file at the pinned commit; the copy in source/ is the file as built.
- This copy of the harness could not be matched to an upstream file at a pinned commit, so it is marked modified; it is the file as built.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch wolfssh` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_server.plain` | 313,720 | `02d204abdd756a3bf4cf80c192d1645a1b4c4555be0e60eed8af5e034237dae7` |
| ubsan | `fuzz_server.ubsan` | 324,344 | `43f18559678041046ea835e3c60ae4280b34d74aa8e248b922e0c7f3cfc45f81` |
| asan | `fuzz_server.asan` | 952,888 | `7a14cd7d59e29e82ac998c547c15754c6646f63b99025e7b536c26686427d079` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_server.asan-ubsan` | 958,360 | `05e76b2a11e005906c6caa2db85384ff76d61b3a47d81bede2f6f49f65fab7a5` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libwolfssl.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libwolfssl.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libwolfssl.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libwolfssl.a` (a library from the build image)
